main_text.p: dum exagitauit. Neq; propterea legim[?] horum utrumuis, vel ipsum Episcopum Romanū, hunc Imperatorē Anathe-mate percussisse, q; tamen Hærefi infuꝑ adjecit ꝗ {x}Prasinos ipsa in media ciuita-te suos trucidantes aducersarios, nō mo-dō Legib[?] non cohibuerit; sed præmijs ꝑsequutus sit. Item, ꝗ ducem {y}Belisariū de Repub. optimè meritum, honoribꝰ pariter & visu indigne priuauerit; denique, q; {z}Tribonianū præcipuum Legum Cōpilatorem, hominem Paganum & Christianæ religionis contemptorē, Æ-rarij Quæstorem creauerit, & in ipso quasi fi[?]iu fouerit. Quare humanæ cen-suræ non obnoxius, diuina ꝑuidentia, repentina morte vix sui compos, {*}ex impuiso percussꝰ est. [{a}Audite ergo Reges & intelligite, discite iudices finium terra, prabete aures vos qui continetis multitudi-nes, & placetis vobis in turbis nationū, quo-niam data est a Domino potestas vobis, & virtus ab altissimo, qui interrogabit opera vestra, & cogitationes scrutabitur. Quoniam cum essetis ministri Regni illius, non recte iudicastis, nec custodistis legem iustitiæ, neq; secundum voluntatem Dei ambulastis, hor- Euag.l.4 c.31. Crinito l. 9.ca.6. Cuspin. in vita Iu-stiniani. Euag. li. 4.ca. vlt. Sap.6.

page.notes: Left page: the marginal notes are the five entries x, y, z, *, a, placed beside their marks. Doubtful readings: "legim[?]" (abbreviation after legim, possibly legum); "Legib[?]" (abbreviated word with a mark, possibly Legibus); "fi[?]iu" (word after quasi, unclear); "ꝑuidentia" (abbreviation for prouidentia, kept as printed). Show-through near the lower left ("mab", faint numbers on the margin) was left out. The right page is cut by the scan edge, so only word beginnings are visible; the fragments are marked illegible and no running head or page number of that page can be read. The final line runs on in the catchword "rendè" below the text.
